meta.name: review-patterns
meta.description: This skill should be invoked by a review orchestrator (e.g. `reviewer:self-review`) to review code for naming conventions, structural patterns, style consistency, test quality, module organization, reuse and simplification, and efficiency.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 系统审查代码命名、结构与测试质量
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望在合并代码前获得结构化的质量审查
copy.tagline_en: Review code naming, structure, tests, and efficiency
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want systematic code review before merging changes

howto.what: Claude 会按该技能审查代码，检查命名、结构、风格、测试、模块组织、复用与效率，并报告发现。审查范围由传入的文件或目录决定，缺省时审查当前目录。
howto.when: 当审查编排器（如 `reviewer:self-review`）调用时触发。

say.text: 请用 review-patterns 审查 src 目录的代码模式。
say.note: 会按默认规则审查并输出报告。

say.text: 用 review-patterns 检查这个文件的命名和结构。
say.note: 会针对该文件做模式审查。

say.text: 审查当前目录的代码风格和复用情况。
say.note: 会审查当前工作目录下的代码。

howto.what_en: When invoked, Claude reviews code for naming, structure, style, tests, module organization, reuse, and efficiency, reporting findings. Scope: given files/directory, or current working directory.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a review orchestrator (e.g., `reviewer:self-review`) invokes it.

say_en.text: Please use review-patterns to review the code patterns in the src directory.
say_en.note: It will review with default rules and report findings.

say_en.text: Use review-patterns to check this file's naming and structure.
say_en.note: It will review patterns in this specific file.

say_en.text: Review the current directory's code style and reuse.
say_en.note: It will review the current working directory.
